How Wynnyx Works

  1. 1

    Word Assist

    Tap any highlighted English word to see its meaning, hear its pronunciation and read the Thai translation. Switch it off whenever you want a clean page.

  2. 2

    Save & Review Words

    Press ☆ Save on a word’s card to collect it in Saved Words and review it whenever you like.

  3. 3

    Three Ways to Read

    Scroll, Single Page Flip, or the 2-Page Book with a 3D page turn and page-flip sound. Turn your phone sideways to see a two-page spread.

  4. 4

    Pencil Illustrations

    Hand-drawn pencil scenes appear right inside the chapters. Use the picture button in the reading toolbar to turn them on or off.

  5. 5

    Watch the Story

    Play each chapter’s video scene by scene, with English or Thai subtitles and auto-play to the next scene.

  6. 6

    Meet the Characters

    Open a character profile to see their details, spin their 3D model with your finger or mouse, or switch to the original artwork.

  7. 7

    Read in Your Language

    Switch the whole site to Thai, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish or French, and translate a full chapter with the translate button.

  8. 8

    Make It Yours

    Choose your font, text size, line spacing and alignment, light or dark mode, and the volume of the page-turn sound. Full-screen reading is one tap away.

  9. 9

    Pick Up Where You Left Off

    Continue Reading takes you back to your page, and the bell keeps you posted on updates. Search or filter by genre to find your next read.

    Featured Story

    DreamcasterWhispers of Ravenwood

    Dark Fantasy Fantasy Mystery

    A camping trip wasn’t supposed to turn into a nightmare...

    Darren, an ordinary 18-year-old boy attending a regular school in America, is invited on a camping trip to Ravenwood, a forest surrounded by countless legends. As the mysterious phenomenon Crimson Bloom, also known as the Crimson Sky, approaches, Darren and Charlie unknowingly accept the invitation, having absolutely no idea what awaits them once they arrive.

    One of their friends goes missing, and they begin hearing a strange, whisper-like sound. It almost sounds like an animal, yet it’s unlike anything they’ve ever heard before.
